holdings.title: Current Holdings
holdings.filterNoMatch: No holdings match the current filters

concepts.marketValueTip: Sum of each holding's value at quantity × latest price; holdings without a price or FX rate are excluded; cash held in investment accounts is not included.
concepts.unrealizedPnlTip: Market value minus cost basis (FIFO lots, including buy fees) — unrealized P&L that moves with prices and turns into realized P&L only after you sell.
concepts.scopeFiltered: Amounts are converted to each account's currency and listed separately, never merged; the totals narrow with the current search and account filters.
concepts.scopeWholeLedger: Amounts are converted to each account's currency and listed separately, never merged; the totals cover holdings across the whole ledger and do not narrow with search or filters.
concepts.scopeOverview: On the overview tab this is the whole-ledger caliber: amounts are converted to the global default (native) currency and merged into a single value; they do not narrow with search or account filters.
concepts.scopeCrossBook: Each book is summed separately, then converted to the active book's base currency at current rates; locked or uninitialized books are excluded.
concepts.costTip: Remaining holdings summed at their FIFO lot cost, including buy fees; the cost of what you already sold is not included, so this is not the total amount invested; the currency is the cost currency at purchase.
concepts.priceTip: The latest quote: for funds the latest published unit NAV (see the NAV date column), for stocks the latest quote or close; it is not your purchase price or cost basis, and rows without a quote show “-”.
concepts.mwrTip: Annualized internal rate of return solved from your actual cash flows and the current market value; holdings with an unknown inception date fall back to “not annualized”, meaning cumulative P&L divided by cumulative investment, and the two are not interchangeable; it does not narrow with the search or instrument filter; missing prices or unsolvable flows show “-”.
concepts.mwrCumulativeTip: Not annualized: cumulative P&L divided by cumulative investment (contains holdings with unknown inception date)
concepts.realizedPnlTip: P&L from sells, matched against FIFO buy cost and net of sell fees; it excludes unrealized holding P&L and cash dividends.
concepts.realizedGainTip: Realized P&L + cash dividends — the gains and cash income already banked this year (for this account). It excludes the unrealized P&L still in your holdings: a full-year return would need point-in-time market values, and price history only goes back about two years, so earlier years cannot be computed. Dividends are grouped by the year they were paid and by currency, and include the dividend leg of dividend reinvestment (the same-day buy raises cost basis, which this table does not show) and money-market earnings that migration records as cash dividends.
concepts.portfolioTrendTip: Historical market value at each sample point (shares held then × that week's price), converted to the base currency using same-period historical rates; weekly sampling, and holdings without a price or FX rate are skipped at that point; cash accounts are not included.
concepts.instrumentTrendTip: The instrument's own price series (unit NAV for funds) — not your holding value and not a return rate; only instruments with a price source have a curve.
concepts.investableAssetsTip: Cash in investment accounts + holding market value; hidden accounts and liabilities are excluded, holdings without a price are skipped; it is the numerator of financial freedom.

manualPrice.title: Manual Price — {symbol}
manualPrice.intro: Enter a price point with a date: a quote dated today or later takes effect as the current price immediately, while backfilled older prices only feed history without changing the current price. Re-entering within the same week overwrites the earlier entry.
manualPrice.success: Price recorded: {symbol} current price updated to {price}
manualPrice.historyOnly: Historical price stored (earlier than the latest price point; current price of {symbol} unchanged)

trend.noSource: No price source for this instrument
trend.noSourceExtra: Stock instruments with an unknown market are not covered by market data collection and do not accept manual price entry, so no trend chart is available.
trend.emptyNoPointsInRange: No sample points in this range. Try a longer range.
trend.emptyExtraManual: Click “Record Price” in the instrument list to enter a price, then the trend will appear.
trend.emptyBackfillRunning: Backfilling price history; the trend will appear once it finishes.
trend.emptyBackfillProgress: Backfilling price history ({done}/{total}); the trend will appear once it finishes.
trend.emptyBackfillRetryPending: Backfill has not succeeded yet; it will retry automatically later.
trend.emptyBackfillNoData: No collectable price history (unknown code, no NAV published yet, or delisted).
trend.constantNote: This instrument has a constant unit NAV (always 1.0000): the price never changes, and returns accrue as share conversions (shares grow, NAV stays flat).

addInstrument.title: Add Instrument
addInstrument.intro: Pick a channel: SH / SZ / HK / US stocks / OTC funds look up the authoritative name and latest price by code (no exchange picking needed for US stocks); instruments with no real code (virtual shares, portfolios, etc.) can be created directly via Custom Instrument.
addInstrument.codePlaceholderCustom: Custom code, free text, e.g. HW-VR
addInstrument.customHint: Custom instruments are created directly without lookup: the code is the idempotent key, name is required, type limited to Bond / ETF / Other; an existing instrument with the same code and type is reused and its name updated.
addInstrument.notFoundHint: Not covered by the data source? Switch to the Custom Instrument channel to create it manually.
